coverage_note: 00:00-16:00 is almost all English (app/tutor-tab talk, a phone interruption 04:33-05:06 where Medi talks to someone else in the room, 06:38-07:30 mother-in-law call). 12:39-16:39 several Amal lines came out as MSA (بيع هذا في بعض الأحيان / ربط الكلمات / أسعدتِ أحداً ما) - engine translation, not her words. 15:43-18:26 Medi's Arabic was dropped as [speaking foreign language] six times, so his first attempts at 'I got happy / I lifted the most ever' and his two comparative options at 18:24/18:26 are unreadable; rows there are built from Amal's replies only. Echo check: none of the six echo-candidates is Arabic (you know / Tell you about / There's no M? / Uh / Okay. Um / Bye are real English); take_verb, laazem_noun, chat_pairs empty. Engine slips noted: 17:31 Amal's echo 'حملت، ما تعملت' shows he said t3amalt (engine wrote حملت); 38:59/39:16 'همس' = خمس (dropped خ, S4); 39:53 'خناس، خنات' = خمس بنات attempts; 47:19/47:27 Amal's 'أديبة/أديب' = قريبة/قريب; 45:25 Amal 'dash.' = her prompt on e7da3sh; 51:13 Amal 'حفيدن' = حفيدين; 59:29 Medi 'شيكمن' unreadable (Amal closed the list with 'بس. خلص'); 1:00:39 'جنين' is his mishearing of جمع (not the place, not a word error); 1:02:54 Amal 'وفير' = كوافير; 35:46 Amal 'قدرة يعني' = خضرة. Left out as not-errors: 10:51 بطفة/بنفع (meta talk about tags, pronunciation); 22:19 'pound' and 29:48 'venture capital' (not on her sheet); 43:18 كبير -> كبيرة self-fix before her (GR-22); 44:39 بنات أخ -> بنات خال self-fix; 56:47 تلاتة -> تلاتاش self-fix; 58:48 موظفة -> موظفين and 58:54 مديرات -> مديرين self-fixes; 1:02:25 بيروحوا -> بيروح self-fix; 44:53 اثناش بنات (E1 would want singular but Amal herself typed 'etna3sh banaat', no voiced fix); 1:02:32 حلا- -> حلاق (she finished a word he was already saying); 53:41 بتكون (help on the way); 54:01 سبعطاش (logic, not language); 55:13 بعد تلاتين without el- (no signal, her chat also has none); 18:52-19:20 'ever' not supplied (she said it is on the next list). 30:19 and 39:34 are the same أعمام question - one row.
